title: EchoFrame
description: This Modpack is lightweight and actually optimizes your potato without any useless mods that take up storage.
body:
A performance-focused Minecraft modpack called Insanely Optimized was created for players who want buttery-smooth gameplay without compromising the vanilla feel. This pack uses cutting-edge optimization mods, clever configuration tweaks, and zero bloat to extract every last bit of FPS from your system, regardless of how powerful it is.
### 🧠 Important features include:
-🚀 Lightning-fast chunk rendering and load times

-🧹 Reduced input lag and smoother animations. Cleaned up code paths and memory usage;

-🔧 Completely compatible with the majority of vanilla-friendly mods

- 🛠️ Integrated suppored only (for now) Fabric.

Perfect for redstone engineers, builders, and survival purists who desire uncluttered, raw performance. This is your response if you've ever said, "I just want Minecraft to run better."
